messages:
jen: Heads-up — I'm planning to cut the 1.4.2 hotfix at 23:00 PT. Blocking item: PR #8120 needs a second approver before the cutoff. Can someone grab a quick review?
paul: I can take a look in ~10m, will try to +1 if CI is green.
luis: I'm on calls until 22:50 but can give a quick second approve if tests are clean and no infra changes.
jen: thanks. if we don't have two approvals by 22:50 I will trigger the fallback plan (delay cut and roll forward canary). @sam fyi — will need smoke after merge.
sam: starting local smoke now, will report results. seeing one flaky integration test, trying a tiny fix on branch and re-run.
ci-bot: CI queued for pr/8120, running unit + integration suite.
sam: pushed hotfix, re-ran tests — green locally :thumbsup:
ci-bot: CI passed for pr/8120 — all checks green.
paul: LGTM — approving now.
luis: quick nit in comments but non-blocking, approving.
jen: perfect, two approvals obtained. cutting the patch in 1m and will post deploy notes. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Release 1.4.2 cut to canary at 23:01 UTC — rollback window 15m.
jen: oncall, please watch kv-cache / latency dashboards for 30m. ping here with any anomalies.
oncall: ack — monitoring, will escalate if spike > 20% p90 or any OOMs.
jen: closing loop — thanks all for the rapid turnaround, cutting full rollout at +10m if canary stable.
